name: citation
what_this_is: The dataset for `citare` - Citation Correctness, the code half of the
RAG family (layer 6): what the post's `source` field claims must exist
in what the tools actually returned during THAT run. Three cases, one
per source mode, all through the real phase-2 generation path
(method preloaded, detail_prompt, the production output contract):
`carti`: a book title cited on `source` must be one search_books
returned, and a cited page must be among that book's returned pages -
a page number invented for a book whose passages carry none is the
exact fraud this metric hunts. `internet`: any URL on `source` must
be one search_web returned. `memorie`: no search at all, and `source`
says so - the negative control of citation.
The judge half of the family (Faithfulness) reads the same runs later;
this file only checks what `==` can check.
